caption:
Your ad didn't stop working. Your audience just stopped watching it.

Open Ads Manager and add the Frequency column under Performance.

Once one person sees your ad 3 or more times in a week, treat it as the fatigue zone.

Past that line, click-through rate drops and cost per lead climbs. Same spend, fewer calls.

Skip the headline rewrite. Change the first three seconds of the video or swap the lead photo. That resets delivery without a full rebuild.

Check every active ad set this week. If one's running hot, refresh the creative before you touch the budget.
